definitions.explanation: The part that is on the outside or facing outward.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{外側|そとがわ}を{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}す。
examples.english: To repaint the outside of the building.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}の{外側|そとがわ}を{拭|ふ}く。
examples.english: To wipe the outside of the window.

examples.japanese: カーブでは{外側|そとがわ}のタイヤに{負担|ふたん}がかかる。
examples.english: On a curve, the stress is on the outside tire.

notes:
{外側|そとがわ} refers to the outside or outer surface.

CONTRAST:
- {外側|そとがわ}: outside
- {内側|うちがわ}: inside

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {外側|そとがわ}から{見|み}る: to look from the outside
- {外側|そとがわ}に{向|む}く: to face outward
